port_traffic.definition: monthly per-port observed aggregates + documented traffic_index composite

congestion.definition: documented min-max composite of observed activity; not an official congestion measurement

waiting_time.definition: monthly mean pre-berthing waiting time (arrival-at-reporting-station to operational berth, excl. inward movement), authority-published TOTAL over sailed vessels
waiting_time.distributions: median/p25/p75/max UNAVAILABLE (port reports publish means only; not fabricated)
waiting_time.leakage: PASS (same-month join; target columns excluded from X_features)
